blocks.content: With this, you have made the interactive layout of your first project using JS. This is the first part of the tic-tac-toe project.
In the second part, we'll add the game logic and complete it with more functionalities, such as a player name input section in Chapter 5.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
